facts.fact: Genevieve 背对栏杆站在露台上，双手捧着装母亲骨灰的骨灰瓮，等众人聚齐。
facts.anchor: she held the urn that contained the ashes of her mother

facts.fact: Genevieve 与父亲低声商量后，叫 Rose 接过骨灰瓮，把骨灰撒出栏杆外。
facts.anchor: called on Rose to take the urn and scatter its contents

facts.fact: 叙述者把这场聚会称作「反高潮」：她一个人一个人地用暗示把真相埋掉，而不是集合众人当场揭底。
facts.anchor: I came to think of this gathering as an “anti-denouement,”

facts.fact: 众人听二重奏时，她走神去想 Luke Fulton 的尸体在碱水里已经溶到什么程度。
facts.anchor: how much of Luke Fulton’s body had liquified by then

facts.fact: 被问小提琴花了多少钱，Genevieve 叹口气说五千。
众人一直待到接近午夜才各自回房睡觉。
facts.anchor: It was close to midnight by the time everyone went to bed

facts.fact: 深夜炉边，Genevieve 说她不打算再写回忆录了。
facts.anchor: “I don’t want to write a memoir anymore,” she said

facts.fact: 她拿着钥匙溜到院外那块拴着绳子的石头边，把绳子收上来，再放进体育器材棚。
facts.anchor: the boulder where the rope was still tied
